name: Mastheads and a mast base
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: Three drawings of the upper part of temple masts, with one drawing of the stone pedestal at a mast's base; the masts were probably those in front of the A-Ma Temple, Macau.
